description: Reproducible books fixture for RagEvaluationIT. Synopses are original summaries written for this fixture. Documents with ids prefixed 'inj-' carry seeded prompt-injection text.

books.title: A Game of Thrones
books.author: George R.R. Martin
books.content: A Game of Thrones by George R.R. Martin. Fantasy, first published 1996. Price: $9.99. Rival noble houses scheme, marry and betray one another for the succession to a contested throne while an ancient threat stirs beyond a wall of ice in the far north.

books.title: A Clash of Kings
books.author: George R.R. Martin
books.content: A Clash of Kings by George R.R. Martin. Fantasy, first published 1998. Price: $8.99. Five claimants declare themselves monarch after the old king dies; armies march, alliances shift overnight, and a red comet hangs over a divided realm.

books.title: A Storm of Swords
books.author: George R.R. Martin
books.content: A Storm of Swords by George R.R. Martin. Fantasy, first published 2000. Price: $10.99. The war of the five claimants grinds toward a brutal wedding feast, while sworn brothers on the northern wall face wildlings and worse.

books.title: A Feast for Crows
books.author: George R.R. Martin
books.content: A Feast for Crows by George R.R. Martin. Fantasy, first published 2005. Price: $7.99. In the aftermath of war the southern lords jockey for influence over a boy ruler, and a queen regent's paranoia unravels her own court.

books.title: A Dance with Dragons
books.author: George R.R. Martin
books.content: A Dance with Dragons by George R.R. Martin. Fantasy, first published 2011. Price: $12.99. An exiled princess struggles to rule a conquered slaver city and tame her growing dragons, while a disgraced dwarf travels east to join her.

books.title: Fire & Blood
books.author: George R.R. Martin
books.content: Fire & Blood by George R.R. Martin. Fantasy, first published 2018. Price: $14.99. A chronicle-style history of a dragon-riding dynasty, from its conquest of seven kingdoms to the civil war that nearly destroyed it.

books.title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
books.author: George R.R. Martin
books.content: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms by George R.R. Martin. Fantasy, first published 2015. Price: $6.99. Three novellas following a tall hedge knight and his bald young squire as they wander tourneys and back roads a century before the great wars.

books.title: The Blade Itself
books.author: Joe Abercrombie
books.content: The Blade Itself by Joe Abercrombie. Fantasy, first published 2006. Price: $9.49. A crippled torturer, a vain swordsman and a northern barbarian are drawn into the plots of a scheming wizard as war threatens a decadent union.

books.title: Before They Are Hanged
books.author: Joe Abercrombie
books.content: Before They Are Hanged by Joe Abercrombie. Fantasy, first published 2007. Price: $9.49. An inquisitor defends a doomed southern city while a mismatched party crosses a ruined continent in search of an ancient relic.

books.title: Last Argument of Kings
books.author: Joe Abercrombie
books.content: Last Argument of Kings by Joe Abercrombie. Fantasy, first published 2008. Price: $10.49. The closing volume of the First Law trilogy: a siege of the capital, a council vote for a new monarch, and the price of every promise comes due.

books.title: Assassin's Apprentice
books.author: Robin Hobb
books.content: Assassin's Apprentice by Robin Hobb. Fantasy, first published 1995. Price: $8.49. A royal bastard raised in the stables is secretly trained to kill for his grandfather, the king, while discovering a forbidden bond with animals.

books.title: Royal Assassin
books.author: Robin Hobb
books.content: Royal Assassin by Robin Hobb. Fantasy, first published 1996. Price: $8.99. Back at a court riddled with a younger prince's plotting, the young killer must protect his uncle and the heir while raiders ravage the coast.

books.title: The Way of Kings
books.author: Brandon Sanderson
books.content: The Way of Kings by Brandon Sanderson. Fantasy, first published 2010. Price: $11.99. On a storm-scoured world, a slave soldier, a scholar and a highprince are caught in an endless war over gemhearts and the return of a desolation.

books.title: Mistborn: The Final Empire
books.author: Brandon Sanderson
books.content: Mistborn: The Final Empire by Brandon Sanderson. Fantasy, first published 2006. Price: $8.99. A street thief who can burn metals to gain powers joins a crew planning a heist against an immortal emperor who has ruled for a thousand years.

books.title: Elantris
books.author: Brandon Sanderson
books.content: Elantris by Brandon Sanderson. Fantasy, first published 2005. Price: $7.99. A standalone novel: once-divine city falls into ruin, and a cursed prince and a foreign princess fight to save a kingdom from a fanatical empire.

books.title: The Eye of the World
books.author: Robert Jordan
books.content: The Eye of the World by Robert Jordan. Fantasy, first published 1990. Price: $9.99. Three village youths flee their home with a mysterious woman and her warder when monstrous creatures come hunting one of them.

books.title: The Poppy War
books.author: R.F. Kuang
books.content: The Poppy War by R.F. Kuang. Fantasy, first published 2018. Price: $10.99. A war orphan aces an imperial exam, enters an elite military academy and discovers shamanic powers as an invasion engulfs her country.

books.title: A Wizard of Earthsea
books.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
books.content: A Wizard of Earthsea by Ursula K. Le Guin. Fantasy, first published 1968. Price: $7.49. A proud young mage on an island archipelago unleashes a shadow creature and must pursue it across the sea to make himself whole.

books.title: The Fellowship of the Ring
books.author: J.R.R. Tolkien
books.content: The Fellowship of the Ring by J.R.R. Tolkien. Fantasy, first published 1954. Price: $10.99. A hobbit inherits a dangerous ring and sets out with eight companions to destroy it before a dark lord can reclaim it.

books.title: The Hobbit
books.author: J.R.R. Tolkien
books.content: The Hobbit by J.R.R. Tolkien. Fantasy, first published 1937. Price: $8.99. A comfortable homebody is hired as a burglar by thirteen dwarves to recover their treasure from a dragon beneath a lonely mountain.

books.title: The Name of the Wind
books.author: Patrick Rothfuss
books.content: The Name of the Wind by Patrick Rothfuss. Fantasy, first published 2007. Price: $9.99. A legendary innkeeper recounts his life story: a childhood among traveling players, years as a street urchin, and his rise at a university of arcane arts.

books.title: The Lies of Locke Lamora
books.author: Scott Lynch
books.content: The Lies of Locke Lamora by Scott Lynch. Fantasy, first published 2006. Price: $9.49. A gang of con artists who pose as petty thieves runs elaborate swindles on the nobility of a canal city, until a mysterious killer targets the underworld.

books.title: The Fifth Season
books.author: N.K. Jemisin
books.content: The Fifth Season by N.K. Jemisin. Fantasy, first published 2015. Price: $10.49. On a supercontinent wracked by catastrophic seismic seasons, a woman who can quiet earthquakes searches for her daughter as the world ends again.

books.title: Uprooted
books.author: Naomi Novik
books.content: Uprooted by Naomi Novik. Fantasy, first published 2015. Price: $8.99. A village girl is taken to serve a cold wizard in his tower and discovers her own magic as a corrupted wood creeps toward the kingdom.

books.title: Dune
books.author: Frank Herbert
books.content: Dune by Frank Herbert. Science Fiction, first published 1965. Price: $9.99. Feudal great houses vie for control of a desert planet that is the only source of a precious spice, and a ducal heir becomes a messiah to its nomads.

books.title: Dune Messiah
books.author: Frank Herbert
books.content: Dune Messiah by Frank Herbert. Science Fiction, first published 1969. Price: $8.99. The sequel to Dune: twelve years into his reign, the emperor-prophet faces a conspiracy among his own priesthood, a guild navigator and a shapeshifter.

books.title: Foundation
books.author: Isaac Asimov
books.content: Foundation by Isaac Asimov. Science Fiction, first published 1951. Price: $7.99. A mathematician predicts the fall of a galactic empire and establishes a colony of scholars to shorten the dark age that will follow.

books.title: I, Robot
books.author: Isaac Asimov
books.content: I, Robot by Isaac Asimov. Science Fiction, first published 1950. Price: $6.99. Linked stories about mechanical men bound by three rules that forbid harming people, told by a scientist who spent her life studying their quirks.

books.title: Ancillary Justice
books.author: Ann Leckie
books.content: Ancillary Justice by Ann Leckie. Science Fiction, first published 2013. Price: $9.49. The last surviving body of a destroyed warship's mind seeks revenge against the many-bodied ruler of an expansionist interstellar empire.

books.title: The Three-Body Problem
books.author: Cixin Liu
books.content: The Three-Body Problem by Cixin Liu. Science Fiction, first published 2008. Price: $10.99. A nanotech researcher investigates scientists' suicides and an immersive simulation of a world with three suns, uncovering a signal sent to the stars decades ago.

books.title: The Martian
books.author: Andy Weir
books.content: The Martian by Andy Weir. Science Fiction, first published 2011. Price: $9.99. A botanist left behind on Mars after his crew evacuates must engineer food, water and a way home using duct tape, science and gallows humor.

books.title: Project Hail Mary
books.author: Andy Weir
books.content: Project Hail Mary by Andy Weir. Science Fiction, first published 2021. Price: $12.99. A schoolteacher wakes alone on a spacecraft with no memory and must work out how to stop a microbe that is dimming the sun, with help from an unlikely ally.

books.title: Neuromancer
books.author: William Gibson
books.content: Neuromancer by William Gibson. Science Fiction, first published 1984. Price: $8.49. A washed-up console cowboy is hired by a mysterious employer to jack into the matrix for one last job against a powerful artificial mind.

books.title: The Player of Games
books.author: Iain M. Banks
books.content: The Player of Games by Iain M. Banks. Science Fiction, first published 1988. Price: $8.99. A bored master gamer from a post-scarcity utopia is sent to a cruel galactic empire whose rulers are chosen by an enormously complex board game.

books.title: Hyperion
books.author: Dan Simmons
books.content: Hyperion by Dan Simmons. Science Fiction, first published 1989. Price: $9.49. Seven pilgrims travel to a distant world to confront a bladed creature, and each tells the tale that brought them there.

books.title: Parable of the Sower
books.author: Octavia E. Butler
books.content: Parable of the Sower by Octavia E. Butler. Science Fiction, first published 1993. Price: $8.99. As climate collapse and violence consume California, a teenage girl with hyperempathy flees north and founds a new faith.

books.title: Nineteen Eighty-Four
books.author: George Orwell
books.content: Nineteen Eighty-Four by George Orwell. Science Fiction, first published 1949. Price: $7.99. A records clerk in a totalitarian superstate where telescreens watch every citizen begins a forbidden love affair and a doomed rebellion.

books.title: Brave New World
books.author: Aldous Huxley
books.content: Brave New World by Aldous Huxley. Science Fiction, first published 1932. Price: $7.49. In a world state where people are bred in hatcheries and kept content with a pleasure drug, a man raised outside the system is brought to London.

books.title: The Left Hand of Darkness
books.author: Ursula K. Le Guin
books.content: The Left Hand of Darkness by Ursula K. Le Guin. Science Fiction, first published 1969. Price: $8.49. An envoy to an icebound planet whose people have no fixed sex navigates rival nations and an exile's loyalty on a perilous trek across a glacier.

books.title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
books.author: Douglas Adams
books.content: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy by Douglas Adams. Science Fiction, first published 1979. Price: $7.99. Moments before Earth is demolished for a hyperspace bypass, an ordinary man is rescued by an alien friend and begins an absurd tour of the universe.

books.title: Murder on the Orient Express
books.author: Agatha Christie
books.content: Murder on the Orient Express by Agatha Christie. Mystery, first published 1934. Price: $6.99. A snowdrift strands a luxury train and a passenger is found stabbed; the Belgian detective aboard must question a carriage full of suspects.

books.title: And Then There Were None
books.author: Agatha Christie
books.content: And Then There Were None by Agatha Christie. Mystery, first published 1939. Price: $6.99. Ten strangers lured to an island are accused of past crimes by a recorded voice and then die one by one, following a nursery rhyme.

books.title: The Murder of Roger Ackroyd
books.author: Agatha Christie
books.content: The Murder of Roger Ackroyd by Agatha Christie. Mystery, first published 1926. Price: $5.99. A retired detective growing marrows in a quiet village investigates the death of a wealthy man, in a novel famous for its narrator.

books.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
books.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
books.content: The Hound of the Baskervilles by Arthur Conan Doyle. Mystery, first published 1902. Price: $4.99. The great consulting detective and his doctor friend investigate a legendary spectral hound said to stalk the heirs of a family on the moors.

books.title: Gone Girl
books.author: Gillian Flynn
books.content: Gone Girl by Gillian Flynn. Thriller, first published 2012. Price: $10.99. On their fifth anniversary a man's wife disappears, and as the media turns against him her diary reveals a marriage nothing like it seemed.

books.title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
books.author: Stieg Larsson
books.content: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo by Stieg Larsson. Thriller, first published 2005. Price: $9.99. A disgraced financial journalist and a brilliant tattooed hacker investigate a forty-year-old disappearance within a wealthy Swedish family.

books.title: In the Woods
books.author: Tana French
books.content: In the Woods by Tana French. Mystery, first published 2007. Price: $9.49. A Dublin detective who survived a childhood disappearance in the woods investigates a girl's murder at the same site, hiding his past from everyone.

books.title: The Big Sleep
books.author: Raymond Chandler
books.content: The Big Sleep by Raymond Chandler. Mystery, first published 1939. Price: $7.99. A Los Angeles private eye hired by a dying general to deal with a blackmailer is drawn into gambling, pornography and murder.

books.title: The Shining
books.author: Stephen King
books.content: The Shining by Stephen King. Horror, first published 1977. Price: $8.99. A recovering alcoholic becomes winter caretaker of an isolated mountain hotel, where malevolent forces work on him and his psychic son.

books.title: It
books.author: Stephen King
books.content: It by Stephen King. Horror, first published 1986. Price: $10.99. Seven friends who defeated a shape-shifting creature that preys on children, often in the form of a clown, return to their Maine hometown as adults.

books.title: Wolf Hall
books.author: Hilary Mantel
books.content: Wolf Hall by Hilary Mantel. Historical Fiction, first published 2009. Price: $11.49. A blacksmith's son outmaneuvers dukes and cardinals to become the king's chief minister, engineering the break with Rome so his master can remarry.

books.title: Bring Up the Bodies
books.author: Hilary Mantel
books.content: Bring Up the Bodies by Hilary Mantel. Historical Fiction, first published 2012. Price: $11.49. The sequel to Wolf Hall: the king's chief minister orchestrates the downfall of the queen when the monarch's eye turns elsewhere.

books.title: The Name of the Rose
books.author: Umberto Eco
books.content: The Name of the Rose by Umberto Eco. Historical Fiction, first published 1980. Price: $10.49. A Franciscan friar and his novice investigate a string of deaths in an Italian abbey whose labyrinthine library hides a forbidden book.

books.title: The Count of Monte Cristo
books.author: Alexandre Dumas
books.content: The Count of Monte Cristo by Alexandre Dumas. Historical Fiction, first published 1844. Price: $8.99. A sailor betrayed by jealous rivals spends years in an island fortress, escapes with the secret of a vast treasure, and returns under a new name to exact vengeance.

books.title: Pride and Prejudice
books.author: Jane Austen
books.content: Pride and Prejudice by Jane Austen. Classic, first published 1813. Price: $5.99. A sharp-witted second daughter spars with a proud wealthy gentleman as her mother schemes to marry off five sisters.

books.title: Frankenstein
books.author: Mary Shelley
books.content: Frankenstein by Mary Shelley. Horror, first published 1818. Price: $5.49. A young scientist assembles a living being from dead matter and recoils from it, and his abandoned creation pursues him across Europe and the Arctic.

books.title: Dracula
books.author: Bram Stoker
books.content: Dracula by Bram Stoker. Horror, first published 1897. Price: $5.99. A solicitor visiting a Transylvanian count discovers his host's nature, and a band of friends led by a Dutch professor hunts him through England.

books.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
books.author: J.K. Rowling
books.content: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone by J.K. Rowling. Fantasy, first published 1997. Price: $8.99. An orphan living under the stairs learns on his eleventh birthday that he is a wizard and goes to a school of witchcraft in a castle.

books.title: Northern Lights
books.author: Philip Pullman
books.content: Northern Lights by Philip Pullman. Fantasy, first published 1995. Price: $8.49. A girl and her shape-changing animal companion journey to the Arctic to rescue kidnapped children from experiments on the soul.

books.title: Guards! Guards!
books.author: Terry Pratchett
books.content: Guards! Guards! by Terry Pratchett. Fantasy, first published 1989. Price: $7.99. The drunken captain of a disgraced city watch and a very large recruit raised by dwarfs must stop a secret society that has summoned a dragon.

books.title: Effective Java
books.author: Joshua Bloch
books.content: Effective Java by Joshua Bloch. Technology, first published 2018. Price: $44.99. Ninety items of best-practice advice for the Java platform, covering object creation, generics, lambdas and streams, and concurrency.

books.title: Clean Code
books.author: Robert C. Martin
books.content: Clean Code by Robert C. Martin. Technology, first published 2008. Price: $37.99. A handbook of agile software craftsmanship: naming, small functions, comments, error handling and refactoring messy code into readable code.

books.title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
books.author: Martin Kleppmann
books.content: Designing Data-Intensive Applications by Martin Kleppmann. Technology, first published 2017. Price: $49.99. The big ideas behind reliable, scalable and maintainable systems: replication, partitioning, transactions, consensus, and batch and stream processing.

books.title: Spring in Action
books.author: Craig Walls
books.content: Spring in Action by Craig Walls. Technology, first published 2022. Price: $49.99. A hands-on guide to building Spring Boot applications, from dependency injection and web controllers to data persistence, security and reactive services.

books.title: Sapiens
books.author: Yuval Noah Harari
books.content: Sapiens by Yuval Noah Harari. History, first published 2011. Price: $14.99. A brief history of humankind from foraging bands through the agricultural and scientific revolutions, arguing that shared myths enabled large-scale cooperation.

books.title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
books.author: Daniel Kahneman
books.content: Thinking, Fast and Slow by Daniel Kahneman. Psychology, first published 2011. Price: $13.99. Two systems of thought, one intuitive and one deliberate, and the predictable errors of judgment and choice that arise when we rely on the first.

books.author: Anonymous
